messages.text:
BL-1478 — handoffd's four compiled-tool sweeps (resource-sample, context-telemetry-producer, turn-profile-producer, ritual-ledger-producer) log the tool's stdout only on exit zero, so a tool that throws, is killed at the wait bound or never spawns leaves nothing in the daemon log but its sweep-boundary line: the context-telemetry producer failed every cycle for eight days unlogged (BL-1477); a failing compiled tool leaves one log line naming the sweep, the exit code and the first line of its stderr
What it solves: - Minted 2026-09-07 by the specifier with BL-1476 and BL-1477. Grepped
  first: BL-1102 made a failed spawn return 127 instead of throwing, and
  the wait-bound kill logs via on-timeout!; neither logs an ordinary
  non-zero exit at these four sites. No live ticket names it.
- Article 3.2.4: type de…
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: a failing compiled tool produces exactly ONE e…
